description: A site's name, theme, header, address and every page by path and title, plus its status: a running or failed job (from import_site) and its domain. Call before changing a site you did not just create; write_site replaces the header whole, so change it from this one. With `site` and no token, any live site's name, address and pages as it lists them, a wiki's being its articles outside hidden categories, without its status.

site.description: Any live site's address, as acme.miow.me, acme.com or a page's url, to read what anyone can see there without a token

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: get_site
title: Get a site
